_doc: Magician line cards (jobs 200, 210, 220, 230). #284 (ADR 0006): a card is on offer to every job on the line of its requires.jobs (UpgradePool.on_line), so the playable 212 sees the 200 and 210 cards; Teleport has no cards (every round of a job starts with it on its key, survivor/jobs.json start_skills). Card format and tier rules: see ../upgrades.json _doc.
